person.name: Chris Theal
person.text: Chris Theal is Phytokana’s Founder, President & CEO and a Director. He has 25+ years of entrepreneurial leadership, formerly CFO of Velvet Energy Ltd., founder of an energy hedge fund and partner at Tristone Capital. A former Canadian Armed Forces officer, he holds a CFA charter, an MBA (Finance) from UBC and an ICD.D designation. Email: ctheal@phytokana.com. His LinkedIn profile highlights extensive experience in finance, strategic growth and board leadership.

items: Both have strong finance backgrounds (CFA, MBA) – could create rapport on funding strategy.

company.text: Phytokana Ingredients Inc. is an independent Alberta‑based innovator, processor, developer and distributor of sustainable plant‑based protein isolates sourced from yellow peas. It is building a low‑emission fractionation facility in Strathmore to produce high‑purity protein concentrates and co‑products for the food and beverage industry. The firm markets both conventional and organic protein to manufacturers seeking climate‑friendly ingredients. Although pre‑revenue, it has secured roughly $450 M of future offtake contracts, indicating strong demand. Phytokana currently has no US office or staff and is looking to establish US distribution and sales partnerships.

industry.title: Canadian plant‑protein surge
industry.text: Canada is experiencing rapid expansion of sustainable protein production driven by government incentives and consumer demand for low‑carbon foods. Phytokana’s new facility aligns with this trend, but success hinges on accessing export markets like the US.

industry.title: US plant‑based protein boom
industry.text: U.S. food manufacturers are accelerating reformulation with plant‑based proteins to meet consumer health and sustainability expectations. A strong US sales pipeline is essential for Phytokana to capture this growing demand.
